knobs.note: BH-8048: the repo whose harness-ci.yml merge-queue batch runs are read, one local record per run in state/ci-batch-red/runs/. NOT settable from the control plane: it is an identity the lane reads GitHub as, so only env/global.env on the box moves it.

BH-8048: the window. The run list reads the batch runs created in the last this-many days, and latest.tsv and the case are composed from the records in the same window. --days overrides it for one run.
BH-8048: at most this many 100-run pages of each run list (harness-ci.yml, prequeue-gate.yml) and 100-job pages of each run's jobs per tick.

BH-8048: at most this many unrecorded batch runs are read per tick (jobs, shard logs, and for a red run 2 reads per member gate). The rest are logged as deferred and drain oldest first on later ticks. gh_budget_low is asked before each run.

BH-8048: retention. Run records and strike files in state/ci-batch-red/runs/ created over this many days ago are deleted each tick, counted as pruned= in the log line. latest.tsv is rebuilt every tick.
